observations.body: Jesus is troubled, announces betrayal, the beloved disciple asks at Peter’s signal, Jesus gives Judas the dipped morsel, Satan enters him, Judas leaves, and the narrator says it was night.
observations.label: The morsel identifies Judas and he goes out into night

observations.body: The passage presents Question, sign, entry, command, departure, and night as the scene's observable response or movement.
observations.label: Question, sign, entry, command, departure, and night

observations.body: The passage places Jesus, Judas, Peter, beloved disciple, and others beside Question, sign, entry, command, departure, and night.
observations.label: Jesus, Judas, Peter, beloved disciple, and others

payload.posture: Read John 13:21–30 as one movement in the Last Supper, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states jesus is troubled, announces betrayal, the beloved disciple asks at Peter’s signal, Jesus gives Judas the dipped morsel, Satan enters him, Judas leaves, and the narrator says it was night. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Last Supper.
payload.title: The morsel identifies Judas and he goes out into night
